verdict.rationale: PayPal's own business page says merchants can create a Payment Link to share on a website, by email, on social media, or by text, with no coding skills required. That covers the core of the no-code shareable-link story. However, the support rests on a single marketing statement rather than in-depth documentation. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation the link is created from the business dashboard, evidence of immediate time-to-first-sale (setup steps, account verification), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
